title: 第一卷 第1章 菜人！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

靖康二年。

今年的秦岭冷到出奇，才入冬月，风就疯了一般往人骨缝里钻。

大雪连绵三日，将整片大地染得雪白。

青石沟村一处极偏僻的荒窑里。

“小子，莫怪我！”

“谁让咱们汉人在那些金国老爷眼里连猪狗都不如，入冬了，居然连军粮都贪墨！”

“要不，老子也不会饿到把你当两脚羊！”

“等老子给你洗干净了，肉吃饱了，一定多给你烧几刀纸钱！”

秦云被一盆热水浇醒。

他猛地睁眼，才发现自己双手被反绑躺在一张木桌上。

不远处，一个穿着古装的军汉背对着自己，正在烧着一大锅开水。

“我不是正带着雇佣兵团参加熊乌之战吗？”

秦云眉头一皱。

他分明记得，一枚炮弹击中了自己的指挥所。

怎么自己没死？

下一瞬，秦云瞳孔放大，金国，两脚羊，军汉……

潮水一般的记忆突然涌入了脑海。

大宋，金国，交战区。

我……穿越了！

虽然灵魂交融的剧痛，不断撕扯着秦云的脑袋。

但身为雇佣兵王的他。

还是选择不吭一声地消化所有记忆。

很快，秦云眼中闪过一丝明悟。

原来，他竟穿越到了秦岭北麓的一个猎户身上。

原主与他同名，也叫秦云。

随着金兵南下，秦岭北部沦为沦陷区，生活物资紧缺。

昨日，原主从山里好不容易捕到一只雉鸡，便去镇上想换点钱财，给病重的老娘抓药。

结果回来路上被人一闷棍给敲死了。

“嘶！”

又是一瓢热水直接泼在了身上。

即便秦云是雇佣兵王，可也忍不住倒吸了一口凉气。

“草！你特么的还没死？！”

秦云倒吸气的声音，惊动了锅前的军汉。

“这样也好，省得你死后，做一个糊涂鬼！”

军汉起身来到秦云面前，长满黄牙的嘴嘿嘿一笑。

这时，借着炉火的光线。

秦云飞快地将对方扫了一遍。

除了一柄断了半截，带着豁口的弯刀外。

这军汉连个甲胄都没有，入冬了还穿着一身脏兮兮的左衽胡服。

一看就不是正经金兵。

而是投了金人的汉人签军。

签军，遇战事时，金人会强行抽调汉人丁壮当兵，谓之签军。

往往，这种堪比后世二鬼子的存在，比真金人还狠。

“小子，怕不怕我？”

见到秦云醒来，军汉似乎有了解闷的人，开口问道。

“又不是没见过吃人的，有什么可怕的！”

秦云冷笑一声。

在原主记忆中，随着宋金两方的频繁争战，交战区的粮食价格飞升。

在斗米数十千的乱世之下。

反倒是人肉成了最佳的食物来源。

价格甚至比猪狗肉还要便宜。

因此，盗贼、官兵以至居民互相食，易子而食的事，早已司空见惯！

“嘿！你小子倒是有些骨气！”

“老子名叫孙老六！”

闻言，军汉咧嘴一笑，“你可能不知道，老子最喜欢你这种有种的了！”

“一会儿，老子要把你身上的肉，一片一片削着吃！”

“但你别恨老子，这世道，老子不吃人，别人就得吃老子！”

“对了，这个月弟兄的人头没凑够，千户大人发了火，等吃了你的肉，还得借你人头凑个数，回队里弄个伍长当当！”

说完，军汉扬了扬手里那把带着豁口的半截弯刀，继续烧水去了。

看着炉火前的背影。

秦云眼中闪过一丝愤恨。

把他当两脚羊吃肉不说，还要杀良冒功，赚取军功。

这特么什么世道。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The second year of Jingkang.

This year's Qinling Mountains are extremely cold. It has just entered the winter months, and the wind is going crazy and drilling into the cracks of human bones.

Heavy snow continued for three days, turning the entire land white.

In a very remote deserted kiln in Qingshigou Village.

"Boy, don't blame me!"

"How can we Han people be inferior to pigs and dogs in the eyes of those Jin Kingdom masters? It's winter, and we are even greedy for military rations!"

"Otherwise, I wouldn't be so hungry that I would treat you like a two-legged sheep!"

"When I clean you up and eat enough meat, I will burn you a few more dollars!"

Qin Yun was woken up by a basin of hot water.

He opened his eyes suddenly and realized that he was lying on a wooden table with his hands tied behind his back.

Not far away, a military man in ancient costume turned his back to him and was boiling a large pot of boiling water.

"Am I not leading the mercenary group to participate in the Battle of Xiongwu?"

Qin Yun frowned.

He clearly remembered that a shell hit his command post.

Why didn't you die?

The next moment, Qin Yun's pupils dilated, the Kingdom of Jin, the two-legged sheep, the military man...

A flood of memories suddenly flooded into my mind.

Song Dynasty, Jin Kingdom, war zone.

I... traveled through time!

Although the severe pain of soul fusion kept tearing Qin Yun's head.

But as a mercenary king, he.

Or choose to digest all memories without saying a word.

Soon, a flash of enlightenment flashed in Qin Yun's eyes.

It turned out that he actually traveled through time to a hunter at the northern foot of the Qinling Mountains.

The original owner had the same name as him, also named Qin Yun.

As the Jin soldiers moved south, the northern part of the Qinling Mountains became an occupied area, and living materials were in short supply.

Yesterday, the original owner managed to catch a pheasant from the mountains, so he went to the town to exchange for some money and buy medicine for his seriously ill mother.

As a result, he was beaten to death with a sap on the way back.

"Hiss!"

Another ladle of hot water was poured directly on him.

Even though Qin Yun was the mercenary king, he couldn't help but take a breath of cold air.

"Fuck! You're not dead yet?!"

Qin Yun's gasping sound alarmed the soldiers in front of the pot.

"That's good, it will save you from being a confused person after you die!"

The military man stood up and came to Qin Yun, smiling with a mouth full of yellow teeth.

At this time, by the light of the fire.

Qin Yun quickly scanned the other party.

Except for a half-broken scimitar with a gap.

This military man didn't even have any armor, and he was still wearing a dirty left-fold Hu uniform in winter.

At first glance, it doesn’t look like a serious Jin Bing.

Instead, the Han people signed the army and voted for the Jin people.

When there is a war, the Jin people will forcibly recruit Han men to serve as soldiers, which is called signing the army.

Often, this kind of existence, which is comparable to the two devils in later generations, is more ruthless than the real gold man.

"Boy, are you afraid of me?"

Seeing Qin Yun wake up, Jun Han seemed to have someone to relieve his boredom and asked.

"It's not like I've never seen cannibals before, so there's nothing to be afraid of!"

Qin Yun sneered.

In the memory of the original owner, with the frequent battles between the Song and Jin Dynasties, the price of food in the war zone soared.

In the troubled times with tens of thousands of dollars.

On the contrary, human flesh has become the best food source.

The price is even cheaper than pork and dog meat.

Therefore, it has long been common for thieves, officers and soldiers, and even residents to eat each other and exchange children for food!

"Hey! You have some backbone!"

"My name is Sun Laoliu!"

Hearing this, the military man grinned and said, "You may not know that I like you the most!"

"In a moment, I'm going to peel off your meat and eat it piece by piece!"

"But don't hate me. In this world, if I don't eat others, others will eat me!"

"By the way, I didn't get enough brothers this month. Master Qianhu got angry. After I eat your meat, I have to borrow your heads to make up the number and go back to the team to get a corps leader!"

After saying that, the soldier raised the half-cut scimitar in his hand and continued to boil water.

Looking at the back in front of the fire.

A trace of resentment flashed in Qin Yun's eyes.

Not only did he treat him like a two-legged sheep, but he also wanted to kill good people and take credit for military merit.

What kind of world is this.
